safe_reentry_rationale.fact: Ordinary request transfer allocates a successor generation. Retry bypasses that transfer ONLY after validating and retaining the exact existing hold; no tile release/shrink/new reservation decision is fabricated.

Require same run/chunk/leg/generation/follow UUID/exact full-leg tiles, no accepted FollowPath, unqualified old record and no prior FollowPath send. All four estimated footprint observations must remain fresh and the current body inside retained tiles.

Require current same-scope HOLD authorization/sequence/tile hash within original <=0.5s authorization validity, and latest encoder sample within existing odom TTL and stopped speed thresholds. Existing request boundaries come from initial HOLD or qualified prior terminal stop. Retry issues no navigate permission.

Retry only a real successful matching planner terminal, preserved raw Path/hash and original clock, under the existing local45 four-material PhysX-guided scope. Cutoff-active and other scopes/errors never schedule.

implementation: StaleComputedPathError subclasses ValueError and keeps the original message/TTL/stamp/age. Existing canonical frame/start/end/swept geometry must pass BEFORE classifying an error as transient stale; an invalid stale geometry therefore still fails closed. The expired Path never returns passed.

Before scheduling, preserve original raw Path/hash/action UUID and rejection in history; journal a correlated stale rejection with original path clock/age/TTL. Existing terminal yaw0.05 and full-leg swept subset are also required.

Queue request-phase re-entry with a retained hold snapshot, unchanged generation/follow UUID/full-leg ownership and preserved chunk phase_started. Revalidate that exact hold before each fresh request; skip ordinary reservation transfer.

Fresh guided request uses a new random compute UUID, current estimated pose and original newly observed ROS request stamp. Authored guides and original UUID acceptance checks remain. No old Path is restamped or followed.

Maximum3 fresh retries after the initial computation per authored chunk route ID. Exhaustion raises explicit failure with rejection/exhaustion evidence. Budget clears only after a fully admitted fresh Path or starts anew for a genuinely different authored chunk.

Original chunk timeout includes retry pending time and all retries; its start is not reset. Original horizon/cutoff/global wall limits remain. No new goal after cutoff, ledger handoff, fake action terminal or task completion from retry.
Fresh result must still pass existing path clock, TTL0.5, geometry, terminal yaw and full-leg gates before FollowPath; default/canonical/RTX scope receives no retry.
